name: Lake Creeper Moss
summary: Around Lake Lordamere’s southern Dawning Isles, Lake Creeper Moss grows on aquatic beasts. The Royal Apothecary Society seeks the organic compound as a vital reagent for engineering a lethal new plague.

sections.title: Alchemical Harvest
sections.body: Lake Creeper Moss grows on the hides of freshwater beasts in the waters by the southern Dawning Isles. Lordaeron’s blighted waters shape its unusual properties. Before Arugal’s curse claimed his mind, Apothecary Berard recorded the moss in his journal. He noted its resemblance to traces found on fossils of creatures killed by an ancient plague in the lake. Forsaken agents send recovered samples to the Apothecarium in the Undercity, where Master Apothecary Faranell uses them in his research.

sections.title: Fueling the New Plague
sections.body: Lake Creeper Moss is a critical stage in developing the Forsaken’s signature weapon. Along with moss gathered from Lake Skulkers and diseased tumors taken from local Vile Fin murlocs, it provides the organic foundation for refining a strain meant to exterminate living tissue and the Scourge alike. Though the apothecary who discovered its use is lost, the Royal Apothecary Society continues to brew his recipe in service of the Dark Lady.

faq.q: What is Lake Creeper Moss used for?
faq.answer: Master Apothecary Faranell and the Royal Apothecary Society use Lake Creeper Moss as an alchemical reagent to brew and refine their New Plague in the Undercity.

faq.q: Where does this moss come from?
faq.answer: Lake Creeper Moss grows on Lake Creepers and Elder Lake Creepers in the waters around the southern Dawning Isles in eastern Lake Lordamere.

faq.q: Who discovered the moss's alchemical value?
faq.answer: Before Arugal’s curse left Apothecary Berard a mindless servant in Pyrewood Village, he documented the moss’s alchemical properties in his field journal. Apothecary Renferrel later recovered his notes.
Master Apothecary Faranell receives the moss at the Apothecarium in the Undercity. He combines it with Lake Skulker Moss and a hardened tumor in his research.

angles.text: Each sample brought to the Apothecarium brings the Forsaken closer to perfecting the New Plague and securing vengeance against the Scourge and the living.
Though it grows on water beasts rather than in soil, the moss belongs to Lordaeron’s darker, experimental flora, gathered for apothecary research.
